reviews.text: I opted to go with them after receiving quotations from numerous roofing contractors. Their schedule was significantly more flexible than that of other construction companies. I had a hail storm come through and they came right out to repair my roof. My insurance covered it but even if I had to pay, I would've been satisfied with their work because they are quality people who care about the customer.

data.summary: Reviews show strong signs of being inauthentic or manipulated. Perfect 5.0 rating with only 16 reviews across Google, no presence on industry platforms, and generic review content lacking specific details. Google HQ 'reviews' are actually business directory listings, not customer feedback.
fake_signals: All Google reviews are 5-star with no negative feedback
Google HQ reviews are anonymous business listings, not customer reviews
Local Google reviews have generic, corporate-sounding language
No specific details about crew names, project timelines, or materials
Reviews lack emotional authenticity and read like marketing copy
No reviews on industry-standard platforms (Angi, Houzz)
BBB profile not found despite being established business
Multiple reviews use similar phrasing and structure
authentic_signals: Some reviews mention specific services (skylights, roof replacement)
A few reviews mention insurance claims
data.discrepancy_explanation: No reviews found on major platforms (BBB, Angi, Houzz, Yelp) despite Google showing perfect 5.0 rating. Google reviews show suspicious patterns.
